data.title: The Government of Canada, together with the Province of Ontario, invests in strengthening trade capacity and supply chain resilience through the Port of Sault Ste. Marie
data.author: Transport Canada
data.summary: Today, the Honourable Steven MacKinnon, Minister of Transport and Leader of the Government in the House of Commons, announced an investment of up to $125 million through the Trade Diversification Corridors Fund to support the development of the Port of Sault Ste. Marie, led by the Hamilton-Oshawa Port Authority. This investment will fund a series of improvements to unlock the Port's potential as a key transportation and trade hub, increasing its cargo-handling capacity to more than 3.5 million metric tonnes annually by 2031, a three-fold increase over current volumes. The project is expected to create 2,150 direct and 2,600 indirect jobs while strengthening supply chains and supporting economic growth across Northern Ontario and beyond.

https://www.canada.ca/en/transport-canad.label: The Government of Canada, together with the Province of Ontario, invests in strengthening trade capacity and supply chain resilience through the Port of Sault Ste. Marie
